interface.performance.title: PERFORMANCE
interface.performance.note: Local measurement; performance depends on the device and experiment.
interface.time.title: EXPERIMENT TIME
interface.time.duration: Real duration of one day at 1×
interface.advance.title: Advance without rendering
interface.advance.description: The browser calculates the next days in the background. Closing the page stops the calculation. Computation takes place on this device.
interface.advance.status: The terrarium stays paused. A named checkpoint preserves the previous state. Canceling discards calculations that have not been applied.
interface.advance.note: When the limit is reached, only completed steps are applied and saved. Use Resume to reach the requested day. There is no automatic advance while the page is closed.
interface.survival.label: Theoretical survival conditional on aging alone
interface.survival.note: Theoretical curve, with food and no other risks. It is neither field data nor an individual forecast.
interface.survival.challenge: Infection challenge for the selected ant
interface.survival.help: Artificial experiment on the inhabitant selected for observation; load and rates are not calibrated by species.
interface.biology.title: BIOLOGICAL PROFILE
interface.biology.heading: Where the parameters come from.
interface.biology.help: This choice will be used when creating another terrarium or starting a seed. The current experiment keeps its profile.
interface.biology.note: Approximations, hypotheses and study data have different uses. Check their context and sample.
interface.placement.title: Intervene by coordinates · keyboard
interface.placement.help: The same interventions as with the mouse. Surface coordinates in model units: X from −9.3 to 9.3 and Z from −5.8 to 5.8. The action is recorded in the experiment and follows the normal terrain rules.
interface.offline.title: Take the laboratory with you.
interface.offline.help: Prepare this version to open offline. Experiments stay in this browser; export your JSON to keep another copy.
interface.offline.note: After preparation, open this same address. App installation depends on the browser menu. The private Site remains online.
interface.daily.title: Observed data · daily CSV
interface.daily.description: One sample at the end of each model day (100 ticks), without time averages or forecasts. A/B are exported together. Empty fields indicate no reading.
interface.daily.label: Observation table; use arrow keys to see all columns
interface.daily.caption: Up to 10 most recent samples per scenario. Totals across all colonies; full data in the CSV.
